description: This file defines a PHP class `OAuthClientController` which extends an abstract Vue controller. It is responsible for setting up a Vue component related to OAuth client management, specifically configuring a component with a list of unselectable client IDs.

classes.name: OAuthClientController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for setting up OAuth client-related UI components during the pre-render phase.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with necessary properties, specifically adding a list of unselectable OAuth client IDs to the component.
